notes: No working own site (originaldannysdonuts.com is a lapsed/parked GoDaddy domain; Facebook has no menu). Used dated in-store price-board photographs from the restaurant's Google Maps Menu photo tab, pulled at full resolution via DOM img src (lightbox would not open). Two photo revisions of the same donut/hot-drink board exist: an older printed board and a newer one with price-correction stickers pasted over several lines (All Cake, Raised Rounds, Devils Food, Old Fashion, Bars & Twists, Crullers & Cream Puffs, Small Cinnamon Rolls, Small Fritters, Filled Jelly & Creams, Blueberry, Large Fancy, Half Dozen Donut Holes, Dozen Donut Holes, Half Dozen, One Dozen, and the Hot Coffee/Hot Chocolate rows) - used the stickered (newer) prices per the most-recent-revision rule. A second board photo ('with new menu') supplied the bagel/oatmeal items and cross-confirmed the Turkey Avocado Bagel price at $6.25 on both photos. One item ('Bettys ___') had its price sticker blacked out/illegible in the photo and was omitted. Cappuccino and Cold Drinks rows carried no correction stickers so are presumably still current. Categories reached: donuts, donut holes/bars, bagels/oatmeal (from 'new menu' addendum board), hot drinks, cold drinks (partial - list continues past the edge of the photograph). name: Pho La Jolla
notes: Own site's /menu page links three PDFs. Used 'PLJ NEW MENU' (2-page, current main menu, rendered visually in Chrome's PDF viewer since pdftotext garbled the 3-column layout) plus the linked 'Cajun Seafood Boil' PDF for the seafood-boil items/combos. notes: Own site's San Miguel Ranch location page (2322 Proctor Valley Road, matches the work item's address exactly) lists menu categories/descriptions but withholds actual prices ('see store or online ordering'). Found and used the location's own Toast ordering page instead, confirmed as the same branch by matching pizza names (San Miguel, Bocce Ball, Gino's White, Francesca, Shanna Maria, etc.) against the own-site menu page. Toast only exposes 3 categories for online order - Salads, Pastas, Pizzas (Neapolitan 12in 'NEO' and hand-tossed 14in 'LG', both build-your-own and specialty) - the own site additionally lists Sandwiches and Personal Pizzas/Lunch Combos that are not on this ordering platform (likely dine-in only) and could not be priced; they are omitted rather than guessed.
